name: Elder Lich
description: (Tag:dark+)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:summon+)Race Change - You are an Elder Lich, a higher Undead caste evolved from a regular Lich, specializing in raising undead armies and Necromancy. Though rather disappointing physically, you gain greater energy reserves and magical abilities plus nigh-unlimited stamina, needing only your own Energy reserves to sustain yourself. You study magic with greater ease and gain increased Darkness and Necromancy affinity. In addition, you can naturally use [Lesser Necromancy] to raise your own Undead Servants, your commanded undead are naturally more powerful and intelligent, and you can command more undead at once than you otherwise could.
